maxCompletionDescription: An upper bound for the number of tokens that can be generated for a completion, only applies to visible output tokens (i.e. does not apply to tokens used for reasoning or function calls). Defaults to 128,000 when unset; set a larger value to allow longer generations.
findings: The reviewed ChatRequest schema contains neither max_prompt_tokens, max_input_tokens nor a dollar-budget field.
The tokenizer schema accepts model and plain text, rather than the complete ChatRequest.
max_completion_tokens describes visible output only and excludes reasoning and function calls.
This schema check does not establish a complete-input token bound.
